B.name: Cl@ve — how to register
B.route: online (automatic video identification, or an invitation letter), with an electronic certificate or DNIe, or in person at a registration office; then a welcome SMS to your registered mobile
B.quote: To use Cl@ve, prior registration is required.

C.name: FNMT digital certificate for an individual
need: the Código de Solicitud emailed after the online request
proving your identity in person at an Oficina de Acreditación de Identidad
C.route: set up, request online, prove your identity in person (an appointment is needed at AEAT, Seguridad Social and other offices), then download about an hour later
C.quote: En las oficinas de la AEAT, Seguridad Social y en otras oficinas se requiere de cita previa

D.name: Your social-security number (NUSS) — Import@ss
need: without Cl@ve or a certificate: both sides of your DNI/NIE and a selfie with its front
D.route: online with its 'Solicitar NUSS' button — signed in with Cl@ve, DNIe, a certificate or SMS, or with a selfie and a photo of your ID
D.quote: Si no dispones de Cl@ve o Certificado electrónico, podrás realizar el trámite presentando copia de ambas caras del DNI/NIE

E.name: Agencia Tributaria — your NIF
need: a NIF if you do anything with tax significance — it generally matches your DNI or NIE
without a NIE, a NIF assigned by the tax administration
E.route: online, no visit: Modelo 030 (NIF for an individual without DNI/NIE)
E.quote: Modelo 030. Solicitud de NIF de persona física - sin DNI/NIE - no presencial

F.name: DGT — exchanging a foreign licence (dgt.es)
F.how: ● raw — www.dgt.es/robots.txt read first (public paths allowed); both pages fetched from this machine 4 Oct 2026, kept in docs/products/reads/espana/ (the sede, sede.dgt.gob.es, still refuses automated connections)
F.page_dated: updated 28/04/2025 (the exchange page) and 26/06/2026 (the list of countries)
need: your residence card (tarjeta de residencia) in force
proof you didn't live in Spain when you got the licence — e.g. your residence or student card, or the foreigners' register certificate
a medical fitness report (informe de aptitud psicofísica) from an authorised Centro de Reconocimiento de Conductores — valid 90 days
a licence from a country on the DGT's list of exchange agreements — the UK is on it; the US is not (without an agreement you get a new Spanish licence instead)
F.route: your foreign licence is valid for at most six months after you become resident; if your country has an agreement and you got the licence before living here, get the medical report, then request the exchange — online or in person — from the DGT's own link; you get a provisional licence then, the definitive one in about six weeks (a car or motorbike licence: no tests, fee II.3, 28,87 € in the DGT's own table)
F.quote: Tu permiso extranjero es solo valido durante el plazo de seis meses, como máximo, contados desde que hayas adquirido la residencia normal en España.

G.name: Comunidad de Madrid — school admission, 2026-2027
need: the admission application, signed by both parents/guardians
its sworn statement if only one can sign
to file online: Cl@ve, an @SCV registration, or Roble/Raíces credentials
optional: proof of the school's extra criterion if you claim it
G.route: preferably online (Secretaría Virtual), else on paper at the first school on the application; the ordinary period was 11–25 March 2026 — newcomers after that use the extraordinary process (from 25 June / 3 July 2026), online, at a school with places, or at the Servicio de Apoyo a la Escolarización
G.quote: Las solicitudes se presentarán preferentemente de forma telemática.
